requirements.terrain: Individual terrain/road decals or seamless tileable pieces, not one baked map image
requirements.projection: Consistent overhead with slight 2.5D / oblique depth; readable 2D sprites
requirements.props: Separate transparent PNG sprites per object with checked alpha and matching scale
requirements.buildings: Exterior world fillers only unless explicit gameplay interiors; no fake stairs, steps or ramps
requirements.seams: Coordinate-aware roads, rivers, rails and paths across chunk edges
requirements.persistence: World seed plus per-chunk stored player modifications
requirements.Godot: Separate TileMapLayer terrain, collision, occlusion, navigation, and interactive POIs
requirements.QA: Test walking clearance, collisions, visual scale, terrain seam continuity, load performance and Android memory before marking playable
